newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: STATE BUDGET IN AROUND 50 MLN LITAS SURPLUS.
newsitem.headline: STATE BUDGET IN AROUND 50 MLN LITAS SURPLUS.

text.p: Lithuania's state budget surplus is currently at around 50 million litas, Finance Minister Algirdas Shemeta said on Friday.
The budget was in a 18.38 million litas surplus at the end of the April.
"What we see from yesterday, the budget is in a surplus of around 50 million litas and the monthly plan is fulfilled by around 102 percent," he told Reuters.
The parliament finance and budget committee said in a statement that the budget has collected 491.93 million litas revenues as of May 29 against a planned 463.53 million litas.
The comittee also said the figures were still preliminary and revenues for May 30 were not taken into the account.
But it said that the average one day revenue was around 24 million litas in May.
The finance ministry said earlier that revenues to the budget for the first four months of the year were 1.802 billion litas against 1.784 billion litas planned for the period.
